jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover 
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control. 
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer. 
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product 
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
  

 Location 
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
  
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
THE LAST FRONTIER 
 The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.
 
 ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
 
 We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
 
 Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.
 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.
 
 You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

 Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

 Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

 Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

 Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.

 Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.

 Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.

 Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.

 Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.

 Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

 
 WHAT YOU’LL BRING 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.

 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.

 Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.

 Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.

 A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.

 A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.

 Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.

jobs.title: EMEA Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over one billion interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will drive global adoption of Parloa's AI agents by CX teams and contact centers, owning the positioning, launches, and sales enablement that bring our AI Agent Management Platform (Parloa AMP) to market. You will set how Parloa differentiates itself in a noisy AI agent market, translate our product roadmap into a story customers care about, and give sales the material they need to win.This is your opportunity to define the category narrative for enterprise AI agents at the exact moment the market is being formed.

Areas of ownership:

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Define positioning and messaging for Parloa products, orchestrate product communication plans, and drive cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX.
  • Product and Roadmap Alignment: Partner with Product and Engineering so the roadmap ladders up to the company narrative and GTM plan, and keep prospects, partners, and customers informed at every step.
  • Sales Enablement: Sharpen how Sales positions the platform through customer use cases, proof points, collateral, training sessions, and competitive differentiators built with our Enablement and Competitive Intelligence teams.
  • Market Awareness and Thought Leadership: Source content ideas, shape outlines, create and review content, and speak on webinars alongside our Content team, Evangelists, CX team, and executives.
  • Competitive Differentiation: Establish a deep understanding of the market, customers, and competition, then turn that insight into positioning that separates Parloa from the field.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years in Product Marketing, or 8+ years in adjacent roles working alongside a PMM team (sales enablement, B2B direct marketing).
  • Experience at an AI company or marketing AI products or capabilities.
  • An excellent writer with samples to prove it.
  • A proven track record supporting enterprise sales teams with storylines, collateral, enablement, and individual deal support.
  • A confident presenter who holds an audience on webinars, at company events, and in Sales training sessions.
  • Ambidextrous across strategy and tactics. You have crafted a product narratives and also built the sales deck from scratch, screenshots and all, when speed mattered more than polish.
  • You are experienced at using AI tools to help you be more creative, efficient, and productive.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Pluses:
    • Experience with CX tools (contact center, customer service, digital experience software).
    • Business-fluent German is great, but not required.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We’re a scale-up, having moved beyond our earliest startup phase. But we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Strategic Account Interactions) - Security Solutions
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role
 
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to be the primary product voice for Elastic Security's most strategic enterprise customers. Solid products are built on a clear knowledge of real customer needs. In large enterprise accounts, those needs arrive as a constant stream of enhancement requests, feature asks, and hard problems. They often arrive faster than any one team can act on them. Someone has to bring order to that stream, tell apart what a customer wants from what a customer needs, and turn it into a coherent product direction across different product areas.
 
In this high-impact role, you will own the relationship between Elastic Security's product organization and our most strategic enterprise accounts. You will manage enhancement requests across many enterprise customers at once. You will prioritize them with judgment and data, and make sure they keep transitioning through the system instead of sitting idle. You will be the person a CISO trusts in the room, the person an engineering lead respects for the quality of your requirements, and the person who can tell a major customer that something will not be built without losing the relationship. You will work at the intersection of Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering, building the structure that lets Elastic scale close customer relationships without simply adding headcount.
 
What You Will Be Doing
  • Own the enhancement request pipeline across multiple strategic enterprise accounts at once. Build and maintain a structured system to track, prioritize, and respond to customer-sourced requirements, and keep requests moving rather than leaving them in “under consideration.”
  • Translate customer requirements into shipped products. Work at the level of customer pain, not just the feature that was asked for, and synthesize input from many accounts into a single, coherent product direction.

jobs.title: Knit - Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
A little about us… 
 Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Unser Mandant definiert die Zukunft der Frauengesundheit neu. Wir reden hier nicht von einem kleinen digitalen Zusatzprojekt. Wir reden von der strategischen Erweiterung eines hochprofitablen Portfolios. Das Ziel ist das sogenannte Therapy Bridging. Wir bringen eine digitale Gesundheitsanwendung auf den Markt.  Aufgaben

 Sie übernehmen keine gemachte Position. Sie bauen sie auf. Sie tun das aber mit dem Sicherheitsnetz eines etablierten Familienunternehmens im Rücken.

 
 LAUNCH-ARCHITEKTUR: Sie verantworten die komplette Launch Excellence für den Marktstart im zweiten Quartal. Sie planen den Absatz. Sie steuern das Budget. Sie definieren die Zielgruppen.

 OMNICHANNEL-KOMMUNIKATION: Sie bespielen die gesamte Klaviatur der modernen Vermarktung. Sie überzeugen Fachärzte von der Verschreibung. Gleichzeitig erreichen Sie Patientinnen direkt über moderne Kanäle wie Social Media oder App Store Marketing.

 REGULATORISCHE SICHERHEIT: Sie bewegen sich absolut sicher im Heilmittelwerbegesetz. Sie arbeiten im engen Tandem mit dem Medical Advisor. Gemeinsam stellen Sie sicher, dass jede innovative Botschaft rechtssicher und compliant ist.

 
 Qualifikation

 Wir suchen einen Hybriden. Wir brauchen solides Life Sciences wissen gepaart mit digitaler Neugier.

 
 Substanz: Sie haben ein naturwissenschaftliches Studium absolviert oder besitzen den Status als geprüfter Pharmareferent gem. § 75 AMG (kann on the job nachgeholt werden)

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung Du bist die Brücke zwischen unserer Produktentwicklung und einem der stärksten Performance-Marketing-Teams im europäischen D2C: Jeder Schuh verlässt bei dir die Entwicklung mit fertiger Launch-Story, belegten Aussagen und Creative-Angles. Und du baust den Insight-Motor auf, der aus Millionen Ad-Kommentaren und einem eigenen Kunden-Panel die Produkt-Briefs von morgen macht. Bei Pammys ist Product Marketing keine Übersetzungs-Abteilung — es sitzt im Produktbereich und entscheidet, welches Produkt für welche Nische gebaut wird. 

 Deine Aufgaben Du planst und steuerst unsere Produktlaunches: Timing, Positionierung, Abstimmung mit Performance, Creator-Team, CRM und Shop
 Du baust unsere Insights-Funktion auf: ein eigenes Kunden-Panel, Segmentierung, qualitative Interviews — und die systematische Auswertung von Community- und Anzeigen-Feedback
 Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Produkt-Briefs: Passform- und Komfort-Themen, Wünsche, nächste Modell-Ideen — direkt in die Produktentwicklung und zum Founder
 Du lieferst Botschaft und Angle-Hypothesen an das Creative-Team — Testergebnisse aus den Kampagnen fließen zurück in deinen Insight-Kreislauf
 Du entwickelst pro Produkt die Kernbotschaft: welches Problem es löst, für wen, warum jetzt – und briefst damit Creative-Team und Creator
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 Du wertest Kundenfeedback systematisch aus (Surveys, Reviews, Retourengründe) und bringst die Erkenntnisse ins Produktteam und in die Kampagnen
 Du konzipierst Angebote und Bundles mit und rechnest sie durch – auf Deckungsbeitrag, nicht nur auf Conversion
 Du überlegst dir, was für USP das neue Produkt haben soll, damit es perfekt in Social Media passt und eine spezielle Nische perfekt bedient  
 

 Dein Profil 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Product Marketing, Brand Management oder Growth – idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand oder im E-Commerce
 Du hast schon Produktlaunches verantwortet und kannst konkret sagen, was dabei rausgekommen ist
 Du schreibst selbst: Positionierungen, Briefings, Landingpage-Copy. Klar und ohne Floskeln
 Du arbeitest mit Zahlen: Conversion, Deckungsbeitrag, Sell-Through sagen dir etwas
 Du verstehst, wie Performance-Creative funktioniert und was ein Hook ist 
 Sehr gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Maximaler Einfluss: Product Marketing sitzt bei uns direkt an der Schnittstelle von Produkt, Growth und Founder-Team. Deine Erkenntnisse beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche Produkte wir als Nächstes entwickeln.
 Keine Marketing-Theorie: Du arbeitest mit echten Kunden, echten Kaufdaten und sehr großen Mengen an Performance- und Creative-Daten und siehst unmittelbar, welche Entscheidungen funktionieren.
 Extrem schnelle Feedback-Loops: Produkt, Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM und E-Commerce arbeiten eng zusammen. Was du entwickelst, landet nicht Monate später in einer Präsentation, sondern wird getestet.
 Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du übernimmst keine fertige Product-Marketing-Struktur, sondern kannst Prozesse, Customer-Insights-Systeme und Launch-Mechaniken selbst aufbauen und prägen.
 Große Reichweite: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst Produkte und Kampagnen für eine Brand mit bereits über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Direkter Austausch mit den Foundern: Kurze Entscheidungswege, hohe Geschwindigkeit und direkter Zugang zu den Personen, die Produkt- und Unternehmensstrategie verantworten.
 Starkes Performance-Marketing-Umfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit einem datengetriebenen Performance- und Creative-Team zusammen und kannst Produktmarketing unmittelbar mit realem Marktfeedback verbinden.
 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir wollen nicht, dass du bestehende Prozesse nur ausführst. Wir erwarten, dass du sie hinterfragst und besser machst.
 Steile Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Pammys wächst weiter in neue Produkte, Kategorien und Märkte. Dein Verantwortungsbereich kann mit diesem Wachstum deutlich größer werden.

jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

 Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt.

 Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf.
 

 Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall.
 Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe.
 Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten.
 Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde.
 Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft.
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst.
 Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen.

 Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen.

 Internationales Produktionsumfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktions-, Material- und Tooling-Partnern in Asien zusammen und bist dort, wo die Produkte tatsächlich entstehen.
 Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt schneller Kompromisse: Bei Pammys ist Passform kein Detail. Du bekommst den Raum, Standards aufzubauen, mit denen unsere Produkte technisch und qualitativ langfristig besser werden.
 Wachstum mit Verantwortung: Mit neuen Modellen, Kategorien und höheren Volumen wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich und damit die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Produktfunktion bei Pammys langfristig zu prägen.

 Benefits

About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.
 
 What You'll Own 
 Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

 Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

 Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

 Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

 Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

 Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

 Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

  
 What We're Looking For 
 Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

 Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

 Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

 Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

 Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

 High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

  
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

 Can make decisions with incomplete information.

 Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

 Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

 Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  
 This Role Is Not For 
 People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

 PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

 Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

 People who launch features and then stop caring.

 PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

  
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany. 
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

 Responsibilities Translate Needs:  Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.

 Document Capabilities:  Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver. 

 Evaluate & Accept Work:  Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines.

 Systems Thinking:  A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture. 

 Communication:  Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers.

 Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration. 

 Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context. 

 Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Region Delivery)
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to join our Region Delivery team. You will own the delivery of new compute regions end to end — from hardware handover through acceptance testing to production readiness — coordinating across hardware, networking, capacity, and platform engineering teams under tight timelines.

 

Your responsibilities will include

  • Owning delivery of region and GPU cluster deployment projects from kickoff through production handover

  • Coordinating the capacity acceptance procedure: validating infrastructure availability, quota allocations, monitoring/alerting, and documented sign-off before a region goes to customers

  • Coordinating acceptance testing across engineering teams (compute, storage, networking, GPU) and clarifying test ownership between them

  • Acting as the real-time escalation point during live deployments — resolving blockers such as hardware failures, provisioning issues, or capacity conflicts by engaging the right on-call teams

  • Defining and maintaining clear contracts and responsibilities between the teams involved in delivery to reduce cross-team ambiguity and friction

  • Driving continuous improvement and automation of repetitive deployment and acceptance-testing work

  • Running structured, high-signal status communications so stakeholders always know where a deployment stands

 

We expect you to have:

  • Proven experience leading technical projects or engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, cloud, or datacenter environments

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across many engineering teams simultaneously and drive alignment without formal authority

  • Calm, decisive communication under pressure, including during live incidents

  • Strong bias toward clear ownership and documentation over ad hoc firefighting

  • Fluent English

 

It would be a strong advantage if you have:

  • Experience with cloud/compute capacity management or GPU infrastructure

  • Background in large-scale datacenter rollouts

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture<

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About us Since 2000,  ITA Logistics Group  has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms  LetMeShip  and  ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. 
 Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. 

 Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration. 
 You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. 
 You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. 

 Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. 

 You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. 

 You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. 

 You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. 

 You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. 

 You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. 

 Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. 

 You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. 

 You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. 

 You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
 

 You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
 

 You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
 

 You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
 

 You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
 

 You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
 

 Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. 

 Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. 

 Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. 

 

 Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient. 
 30 days of vacation 

 Flexible working hours and hybrid work  

 Time tracking and overtime compensation  

 Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking

You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.

 This is a great opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.

 Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.

 Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

 Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.

 Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.

 The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.

 Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.

 Helpful, but not required

 Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Verification squad sits at the heart of SumUp's ability to operate across 37 markets. We own the systems that determine whether a merchant's identity is verified, whether that verification meets the regulatory bar in every market we operate in, and whether the decisions made along the way are auditable and defensible. This isn't a coordination role — it's a high-ownership position where you'll set the product direction for a domain that is legally complex, strategically important, and actively transforming. If you want to own something that genuinely matters — where your decisions shape compliance outcomes, merchant experience, and platform capability simultaneously — this is that role.

What you'll do

  • Define and lead the product strategy for the verification platform, sequencing compliance obligations, platform modernisation, and merchant experience improvements with clear intent

  • Own the regulatory surface across multiple markets — monitoring evolving KYC/KYB, AML, and eIDAS requirements and converting them into structured, buildable scope before they become blockers

  • Make the hard calls where UX and backend decisions conflict, holding coherence across the full product surface and owning the outcome when trade-offs are required

  • Run lean, autonomous discovery — synthesising user research, data signals, and regulatory guidance into decision-ready artefacts independently

  • Co-lead the squad alongside a strong Engineering Manager, driving platform modernisation and reducing technical debt deliberately

You'll be great for this role if

  • Proven experience as a product manager in a regulated fintech or financial services environment, with direct ownership of KYC, KYB, or identity verification products across multiple markets

  • Strong ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments — including Legal, AML, Compliance, Risk, and Operations — negotiating scope with credibility and care, and holding the line when it matters

  • Technical depth to interrogate backend architecture decisions, API design trade-offs, and third-party vendor capabilities, and to make coherent product calls across the full stack

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, interrogating dashboards, and using quantitative signals to inform prioritisation and planning

  • Track record of arriving at planning conversations with evidence-backed proposals and the organisational confidence to defend them

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

  • 🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

  • 💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

  • 🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

  • 🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (YouTrack)
jobs.description:
You see software development and team organization not as a rigid set of rules, but as a craft that deserves better tools. You want to design complex, data-rich productivity platforms where information architecture is a first-class problem, and you want to rethink how humans work alongside AI. If you are a designer who values hands-on craft, hates unnecessary bureaucracy, and wants the autonomy to build a team's design process from scratch, this role was built for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

YouTrack handles serious complexity – agile boards, backlogs, knowledge bases, helpdesks, and deeply customizable workflows – across teams from two-person startups to global enterprises. We’re at a point where the category's oldest assumptions are worth reconsidering. Issue tracking has relied on the same foundational blocks for years, but AI opens an opportunity to rethink how software can actively help teams get work done.

We need a Lead Product Designer to shape where project management goes next while keeping a massive, mature surface area coherent, legible, and a pleasant to use. In this role, you’ll lead a small design team of two designers, own the overall design quality bar across the product, and act as an individual contributor on our hardest, least-charted problems. You’ll build a fresh design process from scratch with the full backing of a team lead who respects craft and values professional judgment.

Day to day, you will:

  • Shape a point of view on how project management and issue tracking evolve in an AI-native world and turn those concepts into tools people can actually use.
  • Design how people work alongside AI capabilities in YouTrack, from conversational interfaces to inline assistance and background automation.
  • Develop interaction patterns for unsettled problems, including surfacing AI confidence, making actions transparent, and keeping users in control.
  • Prototype and test new concepts quickly, separating ideas that feel clever from those that genuinely reduce friction.
  • Keep a large, deep product coherent so that boards, helpdesks, reports, and administration feel like a single cohesive engine.
  • Partner with product management and engineering to shape roadmap priorities from a design perspective, influencing what gets built and why.

What you’ll bring

  • A deep commitment to craft ownership, holding yourself and your team to high standards without creating bottlenecks.
  • Comfort building clear, lightweight processes, without turning them into restrictive bureaucracy.
  • The generosity to share knowledge openly and collaborate across a broad, global design community.
  • Clarity in your writing and reasoning, with the ability to explain complex design decisions in plain words.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy appetite for finding the right questions before designing the answers.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held, with a clear understanding of when to follow platform conventions and when to break them.

What you’ll need

  • Successfully led the design of complex, data-rich productivity tools or software systems where information architecture is a primary challenge.
  • Proven understanding of how modern AI systems operate beyond single-turn prompts, including agentic workflows and multi-step execution.
  • Experience mentoring and leading other designers, giving clear feedback that lands and raises the bar.
  • Ability to design unified experiences that cater to small startup teams and large enterprise customers simultaneously.
  • A portfolio showing a range of work from precise micro-interactions to large-scale information architecture.

What success looks like

Success means earning the trust of your team and peers through sound interaction choices and clear systemic improvements. You will establish a reliable critique rhythm and a structured way of working that helps your designers grow. Within your first few months, delivering clear patterns for our AI capabilities, paying down accumulated UX debt, and ensuring YouTrack remains both deep and remarkably quick on its feet.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge,

Elgin Values Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees   Agility  We Lead with Agility   Integrity  We Act with Integrity Excellence  We Empower Excellence Care We Value Care

 Job Description Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders? 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

 What you will be do: 
 Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.

 Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
 Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.

 Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
 Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 What You'll Own
 Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation
 

 What We're Looking For
 Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
 

 Outcome
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
 Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised..
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product Owner – SDV Data Products (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: 
 Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. 

 Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. 

 
 
 Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: 
 Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. 

 Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. 

 No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. 

 Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. 

 Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. 

 

 About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. 

 Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. 

 Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. 

 Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within KIRA's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, salaried employment
Location: Remote, United Kingdom only.
Salary Range:  £90,000 - £105,000 + stock options.

Who We Are

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Senior Product Manager, you will take ownership of how data is processed at Focal, and shape what that path becomes: from the imports that bring a retailer's planograms, inventory and store metadata into our platform, through the pipelines that turn them into signal, to the metrics and reports their head office acts on. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a peer to the engineers you work with, someone who understands the systems well enough to know what is expensive and why and when to push back
  • You are drawn to the seams between teams, where ownership is shared and the hardest problems live
  • You write your own queries and interrogate the answers before anyone else has to, and you can name the business number a data product of yours moved
  • You can change your mind in a technical argument, and you can point to the time you did
  • You have strong judgment about what not to build, and you have killed your own work when it stopped earning its place
  • You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once
  • You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want
  • You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable

What You Will Do

  • Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer's data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other
  • Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs
  • Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on
  • Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product
  • Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer
  • Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team

What You Need to Be Successful

  • 5+ years in product management, including real time on a technically deep product where you owned integrations, data, or both
  • Enough technical depth to reason about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion
  • Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same data: a store manager, a regional director and a head of supply chain reading one dataset three ways, served by one configurable surface
  • Hands-on comfort with SQL and the ability to answer your own data questions
  • Fluency in the analytics and BI tooling landscape, and a view on what makes a dashboard worth returning to rather than merely correct
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from problem definition through to something shipped and adopted
  • A track record of getting things done across teams, and the communication to influence engineering and commercial partners
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, including holding a position they disagree with
  • Comfortable operating remote-first, acro

jobs.title: (Senior) IT Product Owner Data Platform (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen interne und externe Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus tragfähige technische Lösungskonzepte und berätst die Stakeholder entlang des gesamten Anforderungsprozesses, von der Problemstellung bis zur Erstellung von User Stories. 
 Du bewertest und priorisierst Anforderungen (Demands) hinsichtlich ihrer Dringlichkeit und ihres Nutzens und behältst dabei stets die Interessen der Stakeholder im Blick. 
 Du koordinierst und führst fachlich unsere agilenDevOps-Teams, um eine effiziente und zielgerichtete Umsetzung sicherzustellen. 
 Du verantwortest den Erfolg der umzusetzenden Anforderungen in Bezug auf Umfang, Aufwand, Zeit und Qualität und leitest bei Bedarf geeignete Maßnahmen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Team und den Anforderern ein. 
 Du gestaltest aktiv die kontinuierliche Optimierung und Digitalisierung der OXG IT-Landschaft sowie der zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse mit.

Following our €14M Series A , backed by leading VCs and business angels, we are building the  compliance engine for Europe – faster, smarter, and more automated than ever.

Few companies get to shape a product at the point where that shift is actually happening. You will.
